chunks: I will turn away from My signs those who behave arrogantly in the land without truth; and if they see every sign, they will not believe in it; and if they see the path of rectitude, they will not take it as a path; and if they see the path of error, they will take it as a path. That is because they called Our messages lies and were heedless of them.
ai.seo_question: Why do the arrogant fail to recognize the truth even when they see the signs?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the principle of *taqdir* (divine sealing of the heart) as a natural consequence of persistent *takabbur* (arrogance), where the elite (*al-akbar*) are turned away from the truth due to their own choices. It underscores the psychological mechanism where repeated rejection of divine signs leads to a state of spiritual heedlessness (*ghaflah*), making the path of guidance appear alien to them. This reflects the Shia understanding of the interplay between free will and divine decree in the process of spiritual deviation.
